insSteps: Place the flour, sugar, and salt in a bowl.
Cut the butter into pieces and add it to the other ingredients. Work the mixture by hand until it has a sandy texture.
Add the water and knead until a ball forms. Let the shortcrust pastry rest in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes.

Optional: If the filling is going to be very wet (e.g. peaches, plums, etc.), you can precook the dough by itself for 10 minutes at 180 °C. Make sure to make holes in it with a fork, and use pie weights (or uncooked rice/beans) to keep the pie leveled.
Once assembled with the filling, bake the pie at 180 °C for 35–45 minutes.
